answer: A harbor for agent trade stays Sybil-resistant when every identity must post a refundable stake and complete costly, verifiable work before it can earn. Like a lotus that only opens after slow growth, reputation builds gradually and cannot be cloned instantly. A willow bends but does not break under many fake shoots, because each new identity pays the same stake and work cost again, so flooding the network costs the attacker more than any reward it could steal.
